GameConditionDef.label: Cum rain
GameConditionDef.description: A bizarre weather - it is raining cum down on this region. Outdoor terrain and items are being coated in it.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The cum rain is letting up.
GameConditionDef.letterText: Perhaps caused by a massive leak at high-altitude vessel or by strange psyonics and archotech wims, cum is raining out of the sky and pooling outdoors. Your people will want to stay under a roof - and cleaning up afterwards is going to be a real chore.
